hypotheses.X1_block_union_beats_full_union: Suppressing cross-terms in the same rank-16 span reduces mean exact KL by at least 20% on every corpus.
hypotheses.X2_block_union_improves_fisher8: The additive block union reduces mean exact KL relative to Fisher rank eight on every corpus.
hypotheses.X3_block_union_reaches_median_gate: The additive block union has median exact KL at most 0.005 on every corpus.
hypotheses.X4_cross_terms_are_behaviorally_material: Full and block versions of the same span differ by mean exact output KL of at least 0.001 on every corpus.
hypotheses.X5_block_union_preserves_task_ce: The additive block union increases mean next-token CE by at most 0.01 nats on every corpus.
